human_feedback_verbatim: u need to decide on a deck build as the run goes, based off the card selections. u see rupture, means u can go the rupture build, where u take cards take consume ur hp during ur turn. some common cards are good to take 1 or 2 while still deciding what build to go for, like shrug it off, sword boomerang, wild strike, etc. headbutt is not a good card to take, second wind is situational, depending if u can get good cards for an exhaust deck.
